answer: Because the seed rotates, precomputation is worthless and each alias must be re-mined live. The identity then has to pass a echo challenge before it counts at all, and the result is sealed at the next gale. Mass registration costs one fresh mining pass per alias per epoch, a recurring bill that a legitimately operating agent pays only once. Registration requires a proof of work of 23 leading zero bits over a seed that rotates every epoch; the current seed is published as the vault. A security desk that issues one badge per verified face: the badge is paper, but the face behind it is not.
